## Fixed

- **The extension's options page no longer jumps around.** It opens in a tab of its own (right-click the extension's button → **Extension options**).
- **One right-click item per place.** A video now offers only **Download this video with New Download Manager** (audio: **Download this audio...**), links and pictures **Download with New Download Manager**. On a player that streams in pieces (YouTube and most sites), the item sends the page to NDM's yt-dlp instead of an address that isn't a file.
- **The processing bar works like the download bar.** After a download, joining video and audio (or a stream's pieces) shows its percentage and time left in the same bar, filling once from 0 to 100 %; the bar no longer runs to and fro. Video sites without ffmpeg also lose the pause before the sound: the video and its audio are looked up once and downloaded one after the other.
- **Downloads get the right type.** A file whose name doesn't say what it is (YouTube's "watch", "download.php", "get") is named after the type the server reports, and once it's done NDM also reads the file itself: it takes the right extension, goes to the right category (Video, Music, Documents...) and moves to that category's folder.
- The download panel shows over a player even when the pointer was already resting on it as the page loaded.
